# ATLAS Skills

This repository uses project skills in `.github/skills/` with `SKILL.md` files as defined by VS Code Agent Skills.

## Included Skills
- atlas-prisma-database
- atlas-express-api
- atlas-react-view-patterns
- atlas-pwa-service-worker
- atlas-genetic-scheduler
- atlas-mvc-enforcement
- atlas-interservice-http
- atlas-21st-dev-frontend
- atlas-mobile-faculty-ux
- atlas-ux-audit-gate
- atlas-faculty-usability-first
- atlas-shared-browser-qa
- atlas-offline-realtime-reliability
- atlas-design-system-enforcer
- atlas-phase-gate-enforcer
- atlas-algorithm-benchmark-gate
- atlas-copy-and-microcopy

## Notes
- Skill file format follows the current VS Code Agent Skills documentation.
- Frontend tasks must use `atlas-21st-dev-frontend`.
- Faculty UX tasks must also use `atlas-faculty-usability-first`.
- Non-trivial UI tasks should run `atlas-ux-audit-gate` and `atlas-design-system-enforcer` before coding.
